methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for AI writing-assistant tools (Jasper, Copy.ai, Writesonic, Grammarly, Notion, Rytr, Sudowrite, Anyword, HyperWrite) was collected directly from each vendor's public pricing page on the accessedAt date and normalized to USD. Where a vendor prices per seat/user, monthlyUsd records the per-seat list price (billingModel per_seat) at the annual-billing rate with the month-to-month rate noted in the plan notes; flat-priced tiers record the flat monthly fee (billingModel flat). Quote-only / contact-sales / Enterprise tiers carry a null price rather than an estimate. These are not telephony products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan, and HIPAA/BAA/bilingual are null unless a vendor states otherwise. Every figure is sourced to the vendor pricing page on the accessed date; where the live page rendered a non-USD currency, the published USD figure is recorded with an independent corroborating source attached.
